name: B10-0161/2026 (Verts/ALE) – Case of Elene Khoshtaria and political prisoners under the Georgian Dream regime
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Elene Khoshtaria and political prisoners under the Georgian Dream Regime
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and making requests. It condemns the arrest of opposition leader Elene Khoshtaria and calls for her release, along with all other people it considers political prisoners in Georgia. It asks the Georgian authorities to stop using force against protesters and to drop legal changes that limit political rights. It also urges European Union countries to impose sanctions on Georgia's ruling party leaders.

- The report changes no law; it asks Georgia to free Elene Khoshtaria and other political prisoners.
- It affects Georgia's government, opposition politicians and protesters, and European Union countries.
- Next, European Union governments are urged to impose sanctions on Georgian Dream leaders.
